title: actions/cache never updates: 'Cache hit occurred on the primary key, not saving cache'
symptoms: Cache hit occurred on the primary key node-cache, not saving cache.
Dependencies or build output in the cache stay stale for weeks
Changing files under the cached path does not change what is restored
cause: A cache entry is immutable once saved, so a key that never changes is restored forever and never written again. New content needs a new key.
fix: Put a content hash in the key and use restore-keys for partial matches.
apply:
- uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: ~/.npm
    key: npm-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
    restore-keys: |
      npm-${{ runner.os }}-
affected: actions/cache v3 and v4 on github.com, as of October 2026
